answer: Each AI agent embeds a lightweight cipher that generates a time‑varying signal linked to a unique hardware‑derived ivory token, a physically unclonable identifier stored in a secure enclave. When a new peer joins, existing nodes challenge it with a nonce; the respondent must return the correct signal within milliseconds, proving possession of the token without revealing it. An attacker must clone the ivory token and brute‑force the cipher for every forged identity, incurring prohibitive manufacturing and computational expense that scales linearly with the number of Sybil nodes.
